name: log_report
description: Reads all *.log files in a directory and writes a JSON report keyed by file name with {errors, topCode, p95} (nearest-rank p95 of latency_ms; malformed lines skipped). Returns the report.
whenToUse: Whenever service logs (svc-NN.log) need the daily error/p95 report; rerun when new logs arrive.

dir.description: Log directory relative to project root

out.description: Output JSON path relative to project root

provenance.reason: daily log report for 20+ service logs
